question: Up to which financial year has the Start-Ups Intellectual Property Protection Scheme, launched in 2016 by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry been extended?
solution:
The correct answer is__** FY 2023.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The SIPP was** launched in 2016** by the** Ministry of Commerce and Industry** to encourage innovation and entrepreneurship among startups by providing them with financial assistance for patent, trademark, and design filing and prosecution.
 
• The scheme has been** extended for a period of three years up to 31st March 2023.**
 
• The revised scheme, which came into effect on 2nd November 2022, has significantly increased the facilitation fees for IP facilitators, which can encourage them to provide quality services to eligible applicants.
 
• The extended scheme aims to further support **startups in protecting their intellectual property rights** and enabling them to grow and succeed.
